documents.text: Flesh and Bone (Richard Marx album) Flesh and Bone is the out of print fifth studio album by singer/songwriter Richard Marx. It was released in 1997 and was Marx's final studio album released on the Capitol Records imprint. (He returned to EMI-Capitol for one additional recording in 2004.) This release marked an official decline in Marx's commercial standing, peaking at #70 on the "Billboard" album chart.
